The shamshir is the most
representative and beloved sword
passed down in the Flame Kingdom since ancient times.

Compared to other nations'
blades, its blade curves back, and

Its hallmark is deep, sharp cuts
with minimal strength and movement.

Thus, depending on skill rather
than brute force, it allows diverse

Above all, its agility and quick
handling are its strengths.

King Flame exclusively eats
red curry. Red alone is always
fine. But it's not about loading it with chili peppers.

He's not a spice lover; he
simply likes the taste of chili.
Adjust with oil and other spices.

Prince Homura likes green
curry, especially spinach-based

with plenty of vegetables
melted in. Never overdo the oil.

He can't take much heat either. The
vegetables' savor is key. Among the royals,
it might be a taste inherited from his mother.
Prince Hono is a complete chili-head and loves oil.
But he's not tasteless — he wants it properly spicy,
rich, and flavorful. Any color is fine.

Sorry, but I concentrate
intensely during work,
so please don't talk to me~

Getting paid by the
country and taking it easy!
Why are you staring at my sleeping face!!??

Vegetables are pricey too...
yet the money we can spend
Got bitten by a snake the other day—
Mankintan? What a weird name, huh?

It's a Seiryu specialty
or something, apparently~

Even the Seiryu folks
don't know what it means.

Mankintan, huh? It
sounds more like money or
a gem than an antidote, doesn't it?
Win! This is where we part!

My job is to scope out
the curries — I mean,

survey the various dishes in
Flame's castle town — no wait!
Gathering all sorts of info is the job!
